text: 近日，在海康威视亚太制造业沙龙活动期间，海康威视与中国电信国际亚太分部签署合作意向书。双方将以新加坡产业数智化发展为合作重点，结合中国电信国际亚太分部在云网融合、数字基础设施及本地化服务等方面的能力，以及海康威视在物联感知、人工智能和行业数字化领域的技术积累，面向智慧校园、工业园区、智慧零售、商业建筑、智慧教育、数据中心等场景开展交流与合作。（新浪财经）
text_en: Recently, during Hikvision's Asia-Pacific Manufacturing Salon event, Hikvision signed a letter of intent for cooperation with China Telecom Global's Asia-Pacific division. The two sides will focus on industrial digital and intelligent development in Singapore, combining China Telecom Global Asia-Pacific's capabilities in cloud-network integration, digital infrastructure and localized services with Hikvision's technological expertise in IoT sensing, artificial intelligence and industry digitalization, and will conduct exchanges and cooperation in scenarios including smart campuses, industrial parks, smart retail, commercial buildings, smart education and data centers. (Sina Finance)
